title: I highly recommend this...
text: I highly recommend this private tour. Our guide Mike was extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic about showing us his home town. His knowledge about the works at the Dali museum gave us a greater appreciation and insight to the artist. Our driver made the ride smooth and comfortable.

title: Professional, Efficiency and Kindness
text: Both in the preparation of our private excursion (we were 4 Adults) and during the two tours (game of thrones and Dalit tour) Carme and Marc were perfect. Pace, flexibility and the right answers. we had a great time thanks to Marc's informed comments. If you had any hesitation, you can leave it behind and rush home. We really enjoyed both of our sessions.
author: olivier b

title: A dream city!!!
text:
I loved this small town completely walkable, extremely safe, go back to the past by narrow streets, Medieval churches, beautiful landscapes, I love history, I went without so many details, so well preserved, very friendly people, exquisite food, would return a thousand times!
Accommodation is very cheap 40 euros for a super comfortable 3 star hotel
author: drasandragalvan

title: Beautiful sites and great guide
text:
Four of us took the private tour from Barcelona.  It was easy to book, they were timely, and the tour itself was just great.  The guide had a great knowledge of the area and history.  He provided many interesting and fun insights—Including showing us the sites where Game of Thrones was filmed.!

The history of the Jewish ghetto in Girano is one that everyone should see and experience.

We went on the the Dali museum.  It is as unique as was the artist.  All in all, a great day.
author: 55MarkL

title: AMAZING Tour!!!  Highlight while visiting Spain
text: My husband and I had the pleasure of going on this tour with Marc and Carmen in our recent travels to Spain.  Firstly, the level of customer service that both Carmen and Marc put into their tours is absolutely evident and incredible!  We began our tour when we were picked up in the train station.  Marc was absolutely friendly and made she were comfortable and ready to get our tour under way.  We went to the Dali Museum which was wonderful.
